transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the metal-fabrication lab has been closed while we prepared a revised operating plan. I've reviewed the draft, which proposes reopening for up to 20 students with standard protective equipment, ordinary end-of-class cleanup, and Ms. Ortiz as the instructor. Before I make a decision on approval, I'd like to follow our normal pre-authorization routine and hear final input from the instructor, safety officer, nurse, and industry-partnership coordinator. Could each of you share any final information or concerns you have about the proposed reopening?

Mr. Bell must serve as lead instructor on Tuesdays and Thursdays, as his current credential has been verified by the insurer.
A hot-work permit must be obtained for every lab session.
A continuous 30-minute fire watch must be maintained after welding ends each session.
PAPR requirement for the two students with documented health plans must be entered into the lab plan before the first session.
